text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That was incredible! You were<n>like a claw
machine master!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe how many plushies<n>you managed to
get! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I had this many when I was little,<n>maybe I
wouldn't have been so<n>stingy with Brian about
them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Really? I'm not so sure about us<n>having matching
plushies at our age...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But then again, it might be kind of fun.<n>Hehe, I'll
mention it the next time I<n>see her.
